environment.description: Same Laravel 10 application on PHP-FPM 8.2 with pcntl enabled, deployed in Kubernetes 'payments' namespace with Istio 1.19 sidecar injection. An Istio AuthorizationPolicy resource is applied to the 'finance' namespace workloads with spec.action DENY for requests where source.namespace is not in ['finance', 'istio-system']. The policy uses a workload selector matching app=accounts-service. Additionally, a PeerAuthentication resource in the finance namespace enforces STRICT mTLS mode. The DENY policy evaluates before any ALLOW policies per Istio's policy evaluation order (CUSTOM > DENY > ALLOW). The payment-webhook pod's service account identity is spiffe://cluster.local/ns/payments/sa/default which does not match any ALLOW rule in the finance namespace.
